LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Clotting.description: A gentle layer of mana seals surface wounds, helping them heal more quickly.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Clotting.label: clotted wounds
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Ensnare.description: Unseen mana pins the target in place. It cannot move a step, yet can still attack as normal.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Ensnare.label: rooted
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Freeze.description: Biting frost coats the body and joints. Until the chill fades, the target's movements are stiff and severely slowed.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Freeze.label: frozen
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Hex.description: A cold mark branded onto the target. Until it fades, the target takes extra damage while wound healing and mana recovery slow.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Hex.label: hexed
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_LightningCharge.description: Residual static from a lightning strike crackles across the body. The more stacks carried, the harder the next lightning strike hits.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_LightningCharge.label: charged
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_MechAssimilation.description: Foreign mana is forcing its way through this mechanoid's command circuits, leaving it stunned. If the caster's channeling is interrupted, assimilation fails immediately.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_MechAssimilation.label: being assimilated
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_MechControlled.description: Its command circuits have been briefly overwritten by magic, placing it under the caster's faction without using mechanitor bandwidth. Once the effect expires, it reverts to its original faction and is undrafted.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_MechControlled.label: temporarily controlled
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Scorch.description: Residual arcane flame clings to the surface, continuing to sear the target without igniting anything nearby.
LanguageData.WotF_Hediff_Scorch.label: scorched
